rules.accepted_credit_types: CE approved by the Arkansas Tripartite Committee on Continuing Pharmacy Education; at least 12 of the 30 hours must be ACPE-accredited; CE approved by other state boards accepted where a reciprocal arrangement exists (0.1 CEU = 1 contact hour)
rules.alternatives: Board of Pharmacy Specialties certification awarded during the biennium satisfies that biennium (subject to Tripartite Committee approval); postgraduate health professional coursework may also count.
rules.audit_note: Certify completion on the renewal form; keep certificates 4 years and show them to the Board on request.
rules.notes: At least 12 of the 30 hours must be live contact hours. Licenses expire Dec 31 of odd-numbered years. Renewal fee $75 per year. Inactive status possible without CE; missed hours must be made up to reactivate.
rules.rule_quote: (1) Thirty (30) hours of continuing education each biennium, as approved by the Arkansas Tripartite Committee on Continuing Pharmacy Education;
